Definition: a sprout (usually concrete), literal or figurative
BiblicalUsage: Tsemach is the sprout — and the Branch, the name the prophets give the Messiah. Jeremiah promises a righteous Branch raised up to David, a King who will reign and prosper; Zechariah says, behold the man whose name is The BRANCH, who shall build the temple of the LORD; and Isaiah says in that day the Branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious. What grows in the garden becomes, in the prophets, the Person God sends.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Branch is Jesus — the sprout from David's cut-down line, growing where nothing should grow. My position is that God keeps His promises the way He grows a branch: slowly, surely, and from a root nobody was watching. I hold that the Branch who builds the temple is the same one who is the temple, and He reigns now.
